sources.title: Week 1: ACT on PushT - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository implements the first, deliberately small stage of a world-action-model project: a reproducible action-only baseline. It trains an ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) policy on the public lerobot/pusht demonstrations and evaluates it in the closed-loop PushT simulator.
